Class Inventory

java.lang.Object
Inventory

  • Method Details

    • addItem

      public void addItem(Item item)
      Adds the item to the inventory. If a copy already exists in the inventory, it adds the quantities together, else it adds the item directly.
      Parameters:
      item - the item being added to the inventory via looting or shopping.

      public void removeUsedItem(Item itemOnHand)

      Parameters:
      itemOnHand - the item that was used up by the Player.
